component.name: Heading
component.description: A text element that titles a page, section or content block.

useWhen: Labelling a page, section, or content region with a heading
Introducing a content block that a Text component will follow

notFor.case: Using Heading for body copy or labels
notFor.because: Heading sizes are designed for titles; body copy and labels have their own tokens
notFor.note: Use Text with size body-default, body-small, metadata, or label

useWhen.subheader: Sub-labels inside a section, and feature callouts.
useWhen.headline: The heading of a page section.
useWhen.headline-serif: Editorial or feature section headings. Serif typeface.
useWhen.display: The hero headline at the top of a landing page. Large serif.

useWhen.default: Headings on the page's default surface.
useWhen.subtle: A secondary section label that should read below the main headings.
useWhen.brand: A heading in an accent or featured section. Brand color.
useWhen.inverted: Headings on an inverted (dark) surface, such as a CTA banner or footer.

donts.case: Choosing size to match visual hierarchy instead of semantic level
donts.because: size and as are independent — use as for document structure and size for visual scale
donts.instead: Set as to the correct heading level (h1 for the page title, h2 for sections, etc.) then choose size independently
